items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: As I told you, we had a -- Mabel Mercer, and -- what's name of that singer -- Bert Marshall.

ctx.x: Mr. Marshall was also a pianist, but he was not what you would call a "ragtime piano player." He played ragtime but it was for the dance schools and everything. I'm trying to think -- yes, I did know and did hear one wonderful piano player. His name was Lucky Roberts.
